name: NotchNux
description:
A dynamic pill-shaped Notch and dashboard for GNOME: tasks, a focus timer, notes, music, calendar, weather, notifications, system controls, a file shelf and wallpaper rotation.

Clipboard: the optional Clipboard tab (off by default) keeps a local history of copied text; the Shelf and Notes only write to the clipboard when you press Copy. Clipboard data never leaves your machine.

Network: the Weather tab queries Open-Meteo (and OpenStreetMap Nominatim to look up a city), and Music lyrics are looked up on LRCLIB, only when those tabs are used.

Claude Code: the optional Claude tab reads Claude Code's session files in ~/.claude/sessions and its MCP login cache; its Check now button runs `claude mcp list`. Its Rules view edits the permission rules and default mode in ~/.claude/settings.json and the .claude settings of running sessions' folders (keeping a backup). Preferences can connect Claude Code's status line (editing ~/.claude/settings.json, with a backup) so your usage limits show; that data stays on your machine. Connecting "Approve from the notch" adds a Claude Code permission hook and makes NotchNux listen on a socket in your runtime folder (reachable only by your user) to answer permission prompts from the notch.
